app.title: RCS — Rhythm & Chord & Scales
app.tagline: Three things make a guitarist: rhythm, chord, scale. Every drill runs on the same click.

explorer.title: Scale Explorer
explorer.description: Any key, any scale — full fretboard coverage with the 12-color system

practice.title: Scale Practice
practice.description: Run scales against the click; practice time is logged automatically

metronome.title: Metronome
metronome.description: Three-voice click with adjustable BPM, time signature and subdivision

circle.title: Circle Progressions
circle.description: Take a classic progression counterclockwise through all 12 keys

keyPractice.title: Key Practice
keyPractice.description: Stay in one key, from beginner triads through fusion and neo-soul

explorer.signatureNote: Signature note: {degree} — lean on it and the scale shows its character

metronome.hint: Stop playback to change time signature or subdivision. Beat one is accented; subdivisions use the ghost voice.

knowledge.label: Notes
knowledge.missing: No notes for this item yet.

practice.hint: Run the scale up and down against the click. Put position shifts on a weak beat so the pulse never breaks.

1.title: 1 · Triads
1.description: Make the most stable chords automatic: I, IV, V, vi. The goal is changing chords without breaking the pulse.

2.title: 2 · Full diatonic
2.description: Add ii, iii and vii°, and walk all seven chords of the key.

3.title: 3 · Sevenths
3.description: Trade triads for sevenths and hear the difference between Imaj7 and V7.

4.title: 4 · Blues dominants
4.description: Twelve-bar blues and all-dominant harmony. Get used to the sound of not resolving.

5.title: 5 · Fusion / Neo-soul
5.description: Extensions, borrowed chords and secondary dominants — how out-of-key notes earn their place.
